name: kaizen
description: The engine around Addy Osmani's agent-skills: its commands under the /kaizen: prefix (spec, plan, build, test, review, ship), plus what they do not do — a quality gate that keeps a turn open while checks are red, agent-skills' review recorded by itself and required before any push, no secret committed, learnings brought back when a spec, a plan or a file they cover is touched, the PR followed to looks-ready (/kaizen:watch), approximated DORA metrics, friction and cost per feature (/kaizen:metrics). Stops at the merge-ready PR: no deployment
